ns2:course.label: Seminar in Corporate Finance
ns2:course.description: Theories, paradigms, and models of nonfinancial corporations; investigates the theoretical foundations and empirical evidence regarding corporate resource allocation, capital structure decisions, and dividend policies; covers in detail contingent claim analysis, signaling theory, and agency theory. Prerequisite: FIN 591 and ECON 507.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Finance -UIUC or PHD: Finance - UIUC.
